Name: (AT)Mo Ya and Zhang Han's CP dolls.Custom furniture landscaping.
Author: CiChangAn
Description:
[b]* 介绍 *
*introduce *[/b]

墨鸦章邯CP玩偶
Mo Ya and Zhang Han's CP dolls.

这是一组定制家具美化，应单主要求分享至N网，邀请大家欣赏她的CP~
This is a group of custom furniture beautification, should be the main request to share to this website, invite everyone to appreciate her CP~

大家下载前请务必阅读使用说明。
Please read the instructions before downloading.

————————————————————————————————————
[b]
* 使用方式 *
* How to use *[/b]

确保下载了 SMAPI 和 Alternative Textures。
Make sure to download SMAP  and Alternative Textures.

下载mod，将文件解压后放入mod文件夹里。
Download the mod, unzip the files and put them in the mod folder.

进入游戏后，前往木匠罗宾处购买油漆桶，左键对家具使用即可。
After entering the game, find Robin the carpenter to buy a paint bucket, left click on the furniture to use.
